message.content:
**Font Rendering**
Headings (e.g., “The app becomes a plotting bench…”, “Repair incomplete GPS recordings”) render in the **condensed display font (Big Shoulders)**, not a generic fallback.

**Visual & Layout Defects**

*   **Screenshot 1 — Palette Section:**
    *   **Location:** The first color swatch labeled **“Signal”**.
    *   **Defect:** The text content below the hex code (`What the app reconstructs...`) is **clipped/overflowing** the bottom of its container card. It bleeds into the white space below the border.

*   **Screenshot 1 — Components Section (Map Chrome):**
    *   **Location:** Inside the large map container, specifically the **legend box** on the left side.
    *   **Defect:** The text for the last two legend items (“Open connection”, “Drawn point”) is **truncated/clipped** vertically. Only the top half of the characters is visible, suggesting the container has `overflow: hidden` or insufficient height for the line height.

*   **Screenshot 1 — Screens Section (Mobile):**
    *   **Location:** The middle mobile device mockup in the bottom row (**375 px** section).
    *   **Defect:** The screen content inside the device frame is **misaligned vertically**, pushed significantly upwards. The orange chart line and header area are cut off at the top edge of the phone frame, leaving excessive empty padding at the bottom.

*   **Screenshot 1 — General Spacing:**
    *   **Location:** Footer area at the very bottom of the page.
    *   **Defect:** There is an unusually large amount of **whitespace** between the last content row (Statistics) and the footer copyright text compared to the spacing consistency seen in the rest of the document.
